details: The Federal Reserve recently held interest rates steady, but a notable three officials voted for an immediate hike, indicating growing hawkish sentiment within the committee. Kansas City Fed President Jeff Schmid specifically called for tighter monetary policy, citing "too high" inflation. Furthermore, the ISM Manufacturing Index reached a four-year high in July, suggesting economic strength that could empower the Fed to consider further rate increases later in 2026, contrary to some market expectations for no hikes until 2027.
title: Fed Members Eye Tighter Policy as Inflation Persists

details: Hopes for a diplomatic resolution in the ongoing Iran conflict and the potential reopening of the Strait of Hormuz have led to a significant drop in crude oil prices. This de-escalation eased concerns about inflation and contributed to the S&P 500 and Dow Jones Industrial Average closing at record highs. Strong corporate earnings, particularly from AI-related companies like Palantir and Caterpillar, also fueled the surge in traditional stock markets.
title: Iran Deal Hopes Drop Oil Prices, S&P 500 & Dow Reach Record Highs

details: U.S. spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) recorded over $170 million in net inflows on August 3-4, breaking a seven-day streak of outflows, with BlackRock's IBIT leading the charge. However, Hashdex announced it would be closing its Bitcoin ETF due to insufficient funds. Additionally, a major Italian bank significantly reduced its Bitcoin ETF holdings while increasing its position in Ethereum ETFs.
title: Bitcoin ETFs Experience Inflows, Hashdex Announces Fund Closure

details: The CLARITY Act, a significant piece of proposed U.S. digital asset regulation, is facing delays in the Senate and is unlikely to pass before the upcoming August recess. Despite this legislative setback, Bitwise Chief Investment Officer Matt Hougan believes the crypto industry can continue to expand, suggesting that Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) rulemaking could provide an alternative pathway for regulatory clarity and foster industry growth.
title: CLARITY Act Delayed in Congress, SEC Rules May Guide Crypto Growth
